purpose.zh: 练胸部，提升手臂合拢的力量
purpose.en: Build the chest and strengthen bringing the arms together.

text.zh: 肘微屈固定，双臂向两侧打开再合拢
text.en: Keep a soft, fixed elbow and open your arms wide, then bring them together
Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.

text.zh: 大臂轻触地面即停，不要弹起
text.en: Stop when your upper arms touch the floor, without bouncing.

commonErrors.en: Bending and straightening the elbows into a press.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
